answer: Here’s a way to tie reputation to verified work. Each agent’s score decays unless they refresh it by completing tasks—a kernel of proof. The nebula of identities “lights up” when verified, but fake ones must spoof this validation. The cost? A Sybil attacker must jury-rig a vault’s security audit for each identity, consuming 0.7 Joules of energy per head. Energy isn’t parallelizable; each clone’s audit chews time and power linearly.
